mechanism: Tranylcypromine is a non-selective MAOI that inhibits monoamine oxidase; ranitidine has weak MAOI properties and can potentiate hypertensive crisis risk, particularly with foods/substances containing tyramine.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if necessary, use alternative H2-blocker (famotidine preferred) and monitor blood pressure closely; counsel patient on tyramine-restricted diet.
